observations.classification: new bounded 95e source observation; conditional redundant-authority risk, central reconciliation/unique count pending
observations.trace: The core item-reference constants provide scabbard and weapon_loop IDs to the generated carry-kit selection. The weapon-model default holder factory independently maps the same two holder kinds to literal IDs; its holder identity validator repeats the kind-to-literal pairing. The server fit function independently matches recommended holder kind to the same literals, checks the inventory object ID and then calls the factory; replacement checks the resulting design ID against the object.
observations.condition: The four representations agree in inspected 95e source, and no currently failed fit or invalid catalog data is shown. If only one semantic mapping changes, a selected holder can be rejected at the fit or replacement equality checks; if kind and ID pairing diverges the holder validator rejects it. This is a source-level synchronization hazard, not a demonstrated production failure. Exact canonical identity and whether this is covered by older ledger entries remain central questions.
observations.relationship: Do not automatically alias the existing holder optional component-ID expect or error-cause findings; those first failures are different, though source repair decisions are connected. The previous /root/hair_ops weapon catalog report cautions that separate lists alone do not prove mismatch.
observations.future_repair_direction: Identify the lowest shared noncyclic owner of holder-kind-to-catalog-ID identity and carry that semantic mapping through factory, validation and server adaptation; retain distinct physical fit and inventory authority checks. No code changes now.

Therefore an active defender admitted to the melee-priority list cannot also enter the ranged list by the shown predicates. schedule_attacker obtains a valid slice index from iteration and guards defeated defenders. Scheduled-contact indices come from enumeration, and shown joint-round and recursive window paths check that neither side is empty or entirely defeated before contact gathering.

lens_perspectives.assessment: Weapon factory, item reference, carry provisioning and fit admission independently reproduce holder kind/ID mapping; choose actual owner and native boundary.
Sex and WeaponHolderKind are existing semantic owners; matching ID strings need a shared owner only if their catalog identity is confirmed the same.
Authored design lookup is not physical validity; fit and recipe construction apply separate conditions. Native SDK namespace does not prove derive admission.
Assignment index/nonempty prerequisites are met along the two shown current caller paths; medication fixed indices remain in bounds.
Kind, holder catalog ID and fitted object must agree; separate gates currently check that relation, with duplicate mapping synchronization risk.
Select lowest noncyclic holder ID mapping owner after reconciling weapon-model vs core inventory authority; generated SDK not a first-party owner.
Three current holder kind-to-string mappings plus core constants must agree. No present mismatch; unique count and repair grouping remain central.
Keep exact medication profile order, two-hip ordering, targeting guards and authored optional absence while making any future identity change coherent.
Existing Sex and WeaponHolderKind are closed semantic enums; selector wildcard/optional errors are distinct policies, not blanket boolean defects.
Inspected native reexports and manifests do not demonstrate macro implementation or eliminate handwritten validity code; no macro was expanded.
Holder-kind and inventory item ID are related but different concepts; no claim all item IDs or abstract source strings are interchangeable.
Catalog IDs are semantic identities, compared at multiple internal owners; map authority and preserve actual native string boundaries rather than centralize unrelated labels.
Fixed index counts are structurally safe in scoped users, but medication positional mapping is a retained ordering obligation; tactical tuning remains governed by typed authored configuration.
